The same page separately recommends political appointees for the mobile and stationary source offices and a political chief of staff for the air office; those items are not tracked in this record.

status_summary: On 2025-03-12 the Acting Assistant Administrator for Enforcement and Compliance Assurance issued a memorandum to regional administrators and regional enforcement staff that requires advance approval or concurrence from the Assistant Administrator for Enforcement or a delegee before certain actions: those that would unduly burden or disrupt energy production or power generation, resolutions of oil and gas methane violations, actions concerning rules under reconsideration, and broader environmental justice considerations. The approval runs to the enforcement office, not the air office, and covers listed categories rather than all regional air enforcement. No requirement for air office approval of regional air enforcement was found.

timeline.event: The Acting Assistant Administrator for Enforcement and Compliance Assurance issued a memorandum, Implementing National Enforcement and Compliance Initiatives Consistently with Executive Orders and Agency Priorities, requiring headquarters enforcement approval or concurrence for specified categories of regional actions.
